degree_rationale: Treats the eternity of the Light's existence — what it means for it to be without time, foundation, end. Pure essence-meditation on enduring.
direction_rationale: Inward processing of timelessness — what it is for substance to exist forever, eternity-without-substance-bound. The intellect within celestial received this.
grand_man_function: Celestial enduring — the inner reception of eternity in love.
title: On Eternity: the unchanging existence of light from the beginning
